pieces.Text: A cult master has manipulated his cohort and followers into becoming utterly devoted to him. The cult master no longer takes a penalty to his Leadership score for being aloof or cruel. Additionally, the DCs of all enchantment spells the cult master casts on his cohort and followers increase by 4.
The cult master no longer takes a penalty to his Leadership score for any cohorts of followers he has killed or caused to be killed.
